actions.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd

xl = pd.ExcelFile('national_programme_ledger.xlsx')

# Field Expenses
fe_raw = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
fe_header = fe_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
fe_data = fe_raw.iloc[5:].copy()
fe_data.columns = fe_header
# Clean columns names
fe_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in fe_data.columns]
# Keep relevant
fe = fe_data[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Amount (INR)','Posting Status']].copy()
fe = fe.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre','Amount (INR)','Posting Status'])
fe['Cost Centre_norm'] = fe['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe['Posting Status_norm'] = fe['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe = fe[fe['Posting Status_norm']=='posted']
fe['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(fe['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
fe = fe.dropna(subset=['Amount (INR)'])

# Salary Register
sr_raw = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
sr_header = sr_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
sr_data = sr_raw.iloc[6:].copy()
sr_data.columns = sr_header
sr_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in sr_data.columns]
sr = sr_data[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Gross Salary (INR)','Payroll Status']].copy()
sr = sr.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre','Gross Salary (INR)','Payroll Status'])
sr['Cost Centre_norm'] = sr['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sr['Payroll Status_norm'] = sr['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sr = sr[sr['Payroll Status_norm']=='paid']
sr['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(sr['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')
sr = sr.dropna(subset=['Gross Salary (INR)'])

# Cost Centre Lookup
cl_raw = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
cl_header = cl_raw.iloc[3].tolist()
cl_data = cl_raw.iloc[4:].copy()
cl_data.columns = cl_header
cl_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in cl_data.columns]
cl = cl_data[['Cost Centre Code','District']].copy()
cl = cl.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre Code','District'])
cl['Cost Centre_norm'] = cl['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# unique
cl_unique = cl.drop_duplicates(subset=['Cost Centre_norm'])
lookup = dict(zip(cl_unique['Cost Centre_norm'], cl_unique['District']))

# Filter fe and sr
fe['District'] = fe['Cost Centre_norm'].map(lookup)
fe = fe.dropna(subset=['District'])
sr['District'] = sr['Cost Centre_norm'].map(lookup)
sr = sr.dropna(subset=['District'])

# Sum
fe_sum = fe.groupby('District')['Amount (INR)'].sum()
sr_sum = sr.groupby('District')['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
combined = fe_sum.add(sr_sum, fill_value=0)
combined = combined.sort_values(ascending=False)
print(combined.head(20))
print('Total districts:', len(combined))
# highest
top_district = combined.idxmax()
top_value = combined.max()
print('Top', top_district, top_value)
PY"
